name: Skill Bars
author: Themepoints

sections.description:
A quick and easy way to add responsive skill bars to your WordPress site. You can display unlimited skill bars on the same page using shortcodes.

  • Upgrade to Pro
  • Live Preview
  • Documentation

Available Fields

  • Skill Title – Set the name of the skill.
  • Skill Title Color – Customize the title color.
  • Skill Percentage – Define the percentage level.
  • Skill Percentage Color – Choose a color for the percentage text.
  • Skill Background Color – Set the background color of the skill bar.
  • Skill Animate Background Color – Select the animation background color.

Plugin Features

  • Fully responsive.
  • All Browser support.
  • Unlimited Skills Support.
  • Use via short-code.
  • 4 Different Styles.
  • Easy Skills Generator.
  • Multi-Color Skills Support.
  • Skill Title Text color Option.
  • Skill Percentage Number color Option.
  • Skill Item Background Color Option.
  • Skill Item Animate Background Color Option.
  • Skill Title Font Size Option.
  • Skill Title Text Transform Option.
  • Skill Title Text Style Option.
  • Skill Item Border Radius Option.
  • Support post or page.
  • And many more.
sections.installation:
1. Install as regular WordPress plugin.
  2. Go your Pluings setting via WordPress Dashboard and activate it.
  3. After activating the plugin you will see the “Skill bars” menu below the comment’s menu on the left side of the WordPress dashboard and find “Add New Skill”.

Using FTP
1. Extract skillbars.zip to your computer.
2. Upload the skillbars directory to your wp-content/plugins directory.
3. After activating the plugin you will see the “Skill bars” menu on the left side of the WordPress dashboard and find “Add New Skill”

How to use short-code?
When active the plugin please Add New Skill and used this shortcode in your theme anywhere you want to display this Skill Bars.
